step_by_step_approach: Identify every distinct year in the data set.
For each year, total the points earned by each driver.
Select, for each year, the driver with the highest total points.
For each year, total the points earned by each constructor.
Select, for each year, the constructor with the highest total points.
Retrieve the full name of each driver identified in step 3.
Present each year together with the driver’s full name and the corresponding constructor.
